Hoaaam~...What a purr-fect sleep...
Oh my meow! Who are you?! So sus!!
Whoa?! What's this thing?!
Enough Navie! Stop it! Don't be rude!
We'll take them to Erva Tronc to meet the leader.\nPlease watch the ark.
What? Er, okay, meow.
Hoaam~...Aye?
You're a Lixi, aren't you? Please help us repair\nthe ark!
W-w-wait a sec!\nI don't think making him help us is a good idea...
Don't worry, because Lixis like him have the most\ntechnological expertise in this world.
But he seems to have lost all his memories of the\npast, though?
No problem.\nIf his body remembers it, he'll remember it when\nwe start working on the ark...
I didn't expect we could finish repairing it in\nsuch a short time...
In the end, you didn't really help us since you\nonly did some simple tasks.
Hmph! Shut up, Pelulu!\nI did my best, you know!!
You actually did!\nYou handed us the right components and the\nrepairing process was smooth.
Did you hear that?!
That's easy, all you did was give them the right\ncomponents...
Thank you for repairing the ark...
Please tell Leader Atu I said thank you.
Hehehe, okay.\nBut you should come and visit grandpa again\nsometime.
Since we just fixed the ark, it can't be operated\nfor a while.
Also avoid flying it for a long time without\nstopping because we used biocomponents from\nmonsters are.
It's okay if you turn off the engine and just let\nit float in the air, but
After flying it with the engine on for some time,\nplease allow the biocomponents to recover\nnaturally and don't operate it for a while.
Hm, I see. Even though it has been fixed, we can't\njust use it without thinking...So we basically\nneed to walk if we wanna check this world out...
May I ask you to escort Zianga and these three\nhomunculi to Draco Town, and report to Leader Atu\nthat we've finished fixing the ark?
Aye! I'm going with you too!!
I'll guard the ark!
I'm here too, so don't worry, meow!
